items.t: Hercules Metals Closes $50 Million "Bought Deal" Private Placement, including Full Exercise of the Underwriters' Option; Barrick to Fully Exercise its Participation Right
items.sum: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 12, 2026) - Hercules Metals Corp. (TSXV: BIG) (OTCQB: BADEF) ("Hercules" or the "Company") is pleased to advise that it has closed its previously announced "bought deal" private placement (the "Bought Deal").
